Priya A. (AE): Heads up — VentureCare board wants final answers on encryption, BYOK, and EU egress pricing by COB. They said no signature without these.

Marco R. (Solutions): Quick doors: we can offer BYOK via Azure Key Vault for Private deployments. Hosted supports customer KMS integration but with limited attestation. Egress: intra-EU traffic cheaper; cross-region billed per GB. Need exact numbers from Finance.

Li Wei (Eng): For Dedicated pinned to eu-west-1 + private peering, perf for their projected 2k qps (avg 40 tokens/request) p95 ~110ms with current model. If tokens are 60 it'll push to ~140ms. I can run a confirm test.

Priya A. (AE): They said avg 60 tokens and ~15k queries/month. Also CISO asked for HSM attestation and key audit logs. Can Legal confirm if we can add an addendum?

Tanya G. (Legal): We can. BYOK addendum + KMS audit clause required. Need to pull SOC2 KMS evidence and add HSM attestation language. I can draft, but customer must provide Azure attestation docs for their vault. ETA 3h.

Omar C. (CS): If we do a short dedicated pilot we should set a runbook: onboarding steps, certs, peering ticket, rollback path. I can own onboarding playbook for the trial.

Sam S. (SRE): Network note: VPC peering typically needs 5 business days for routing + security review. Temporary VPN or dedicated trial with IP allowlist is possible in ~48 hours. Mutual TLS possible but they'll need to hand us certs or an ACME flow.

Priya A. (AE): Boardroom asked for an "exec-safe" fallback: 2-week dedicated trial with SLA target and commit-to-purchase contingent on signoff. Can Finance fast-quote a trial discount for 12mo commit?

Finance-bot: Quote request logged: VentureCare (priority). Deliverables: trial discount + 12mo reserved pricing delta. ETA 3 hours.

Marco R. (Solutions): I'll assemble a short pricing spreadsheet (hosted vs dedicated vs reserved) and a 1-pager for the board: items needed, timeline, owners. Will include BYOK costs and attestation surcharges.

Li Wei (Eng): I'll run a perf sweep on a small reserved cluster and post p50/p95 numbers. ETA 2h. If they need quantized model to lower RAM, call it out.

Tanya G. (Legal): Adding: if they require HSM attestation we may need an extra compliance review with security team; that could add 2 business days. Flagging as potential blocker.

Priya A. (AE): Noted. Can we provide a temporary statement: "We support BYOK and can include KMS audit logs; full HSM attestation to be confirmed pending doc exchange" — for the board?

Tanya G. (Legal): Yes that's fine as a provisional statement, mark as "pending attestation docs".

Sam S. (SRE): Action items: I'll draft a network runbook (peering steps, VPN fallback, required IP ranges) and open the infra ticket once we confirm dates.

Priya A. (AE): I'll schedule a 3pm sync with VentureCare and ask them to send Azure Key Vault attestation + contact for infra certs.

Marco R. (Solutions): Dropping the board 1-pager + spreadsheet here in ~40m. Also include a short test-scope for the 2-week trial (throughput, models, rollback).

Omar C. (CS): I'll prepare onboarding checklist and slide with who does what in trial week1.

Priya A. (AE): Perfect. Owners recap: Marco=pricing+1pager, Li=perf run, Tanya=legal addendum, Sam=network runbook+ticket, Omar=onboarding, Finance-bot=quote. Aim: assemble all by 3pm so I can present to board.

Finance-bot: Noted. Prioritizing.

ops-bot: Reminder: infra tickets: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/new — include "VentureCare pilot" in subject.

Priya A. (AE): Filing ticket now — will update with ID. If anything slips > please flag here immediately.

Marco R. (Solutions): One risk to call out in the 1-pager: full HSM attestation may push legal timeline; include mitigation (trial with attestation pending).

Priya A. (AE): Thanks all. Will update after 3pm sync.

(END)
